001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.economy;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
004import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
005
006import java.util.Map;
007
008public interface Benefit {
009
010  /**
011   * Gets the overflowed benefit after added new benifit
012   *
013   * @param newAdded The benefit percentage that will add
014   *
015   * @return 0.0d if no overflow or the amount of overflowed
016   */
017  double getOverflow(double newAdded);
018
019  /**
020   * Add a benefit to this ShopBenefit registry
021   *
022   * @param user    The QUser obj
023   * @param benefit The benefit percentage (1.0d = 100%)
024   *
025   * @throws BenefitOverflowException If benefit overflowed after added
026   * @throws BenefitExistsException   If benefit already exists
027   */
028  void addBenefit(@NotNull QUser user, double benefit) throws BenefitOverflowException, BenefitExistsException;
029
030  /**
031   * Remove a benefit from this Benefit registry
032   *
033   * @param user The QUser obj
034   */
035  void removeBenefit(@NotNull QUser user);
036
037  /**
038   * Gets a benefit registry copy
039   *
040   * @return Benefit registry copy
041   */
042  @NotNull
043  Map<QUser, Double> getRegistry();
044
045  /**
046   * Checks if this shop has benefit registered.
047   *
048   * @return Is benefit registry is empty.
049   */
050  boolean isEmpty();
051
052  /**
053   * Serialize the Benefit to Json
054   *
055   * @return The json string
056   */
057  @NotNull
058  String serialize();
059
060  class BenefitExistsException extends Exception {
061  }
062
063  class BenefitOverflowException extends Exception {
064
065    private final double overflow;
066
067    public BenefitOverflowException(final double overflow) {
068
069      this.overflow = overflow;
070    }
071
072    public double getOverflow() {
073
074      return overflow;
075    }
076  }
077}
